description_en: Modifies the SSL connection configuration of a cluster
name: ModifyDBClusterSSL

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SSL connection encryption. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启SSL链路加密功能，取值：

true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: enable_ssl

parameters.help_en:
The SSL operation. This parameter and EnableSSL are mutually exclusive. Valid values:

Enable: Enables SSL.
Disable: Disables SSL.
Update: Updates the validity period of an enabled SSL certificate and retains the current endpoint bound to the certificate. When you set this parameter to Update, do not specify ConnectionString, or specify an endpoint that is the same as the current endpoint bound to the certificate
parameters.help_zh:
SSL 操作，与 EnableSSL 二选一。取值：

Enable：开启 SSL。
Disable：关闭 SSL。
Update：更新已开启 SSL 的证书有效期，沿用当前证书绑定地址。Update 时不传 ConnectionString，或传入与当前证书绑定地址一致的地址
parameters.name: ssl_enabled

parameters.help_en: The internal or public endpoint for which to create or update a server certificate
parameters.help_zh: 需要创建或更新服务器证书的内网或外网连接地址
parameters.name: connection_string
